# bloxone_cdc_destination_reportings (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing NIOS Reporting Destinations.

The NIOS Reporting Destination object sends Cloud Data Connector (CDC) flow data to a NIOS reporting server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get CDC NIOS Reporting Destinations filtered by an attribute
data "bloxone_cdc_destination_reportings" "example_by_attribute" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_cdc_destination_reporting"
  }
}

# Get CDC NIOS Reporting Destinations filtered by tag
# Note: tag_filters is currently ignored by the CDC backend for reporting destinations, so all destinations are returned.
data "bloxone_cdc_destination_reportings" "example_by_tag" {
  tag_filters = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}

# Get all CDC NIOS Reporting Destinations
data "bloxone_cdc_destination_reportings" "example_all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes, e.g. name. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) The list of NIOS Reporting Destinations matching the specified filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Required:

- `address` (String) The FQDN or IP address of the NIOS Grid Master.
- `name` (String) The name of the NIOS reporting destination.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password used to connect to the NIOS Grid Master.
- `reporting_appliance_address` (String) The FQDN or IP address of the NIOS reporting appliance.
- `username` (String) The username used to connect to the NIOS Grid Master.

Optional:

- `description` (String) The description of the NIOS reporting destination. May contain 0 to 256 characters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the NIOS reporting destination is enabled. Defaults to _true_.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the NIOS reporting destination.

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
